from collections import deque,defaultdict
H,W=len(grid),len(grid[0]); seen=set(); comps=[]
for r in range(H):
 for c in range(W):
  col=grid[r][c]
  if col==3 or (r,c) in seen: continue
  q=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); pts=[]
  while q:
